verdict.rationale: Supabase documents several ways to connect to Postgres, including from serverless functions. It also exposes HTTP-queryable REST and GraphQL APIs generated from the database, so HTTP querying from serverless and edge code is supported. The pack never names an official driver built for short-lived connections, and it never describes querying over WebSockets. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented official serverless/edge driver, WebSocket query transport, details on pooling or short-lived connection handling, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query over HTTP or WebSockets from serverless and edge functions with an official driver built for short-lived connections

citations.quote: Supabase provides several ways to connect to your Postgres database, whether your code runs in the frontend, in a persistent backend, or in a serverless function.
Supabase APIs are generated from your database
The Supabase GraphQL API is automatically reflected from your database's schema using pg_graphql.
